system.description:
A modified version of the Shadow Clone Technique that allows the user to create a solid construct from soil, rock and sand in their own image. The clone weights 6 times as much as the user and cannot swim (or drown). You can summon one Clone using this jutsu, treated as your Earth Clone. The Earth Clone must be standing on the same surface as you. The Earth Clone counts as an Earthen Artifact.

The Earth Clone has 20 hit points and Immunity to Genjutsu based effects, Psychic & Poison damage, Resistance to Bludgeoning, Earth & Cold damage and Vulnerability to lightning damage. Creatures who have chakra sight can immediately tell the clone is made of earth and can distinguish the clone from the original.

When command this clone to attack with a Clone Strike, it can make two attacks, instead of 1. The Earth Clone can only cast jutsu with the Earth Release.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the clones Hit points by 10.
